prompt:
INPUT: text only — no reference image is needed; do not reuse earlier conversation images. For the image tool, omit referenced_image_paths and num_last_images_to_include.

SOURCE: Stoutland (바랜드), normal type.

PALETTE: cream, black, white.

STYLE: Premium glossy anime-mecha promotional key art with clean linework, vivid controlled color, dimensional 2.5D shading and dense but organized hard-surface detail. Match the face and armor at the same polished rendering intensity.

SUBJECT: A female mecha personification character with Stoutland as her motif — the creature reimagined as an armored adult woman, not a mascot costume or a creature suit: her plates, undersuit, hair and ornaments carry its palette, markings and shapes. She wears its features as costume; nothing is carried, mounted or put on display. Her skin is human skin.

WEAR: the short black whiskers become fine whisker-like lines on her headpiece; the three-pointed crest becomes a crest-shaped headpiece; the white claws become claw-shaped guards on her gauntlets, her hands still human hands; the tufty, pointed ears become a headpiece or hair ornament of the same shape.

FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): softly rounded face, short length, wide width; soft rounded jaw; open rounded eyes, medium size, level outer corners, average spacing; straight medium brows; balanced nose; full lips.

HAIR: long high ponytail, side-swept bangs.

FORM — LIGHT: one close-fitting armor layer: slim plates at the shoulders, forearms, hips and shins over a fitted undersuit, joints free, a slim readable outline. No helmet; at most a slim headband or temple sensor.

OUTPUT: one dynamic action image that is also this form's card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, no foreground occlusion, face toward the camera (front or three-quarter, never a back view). Default stance is a standing, card-ready pose; motion, effects and setting may be dramatic while her design stays readable.

Chosen settings below override the default stance and camera; her identity and form stay fixed.
Camera: Vertical 2:3 portrait (1024×1536).

IDENTITY (chosen details override the automatic look)
apparent age: 20s — adult woman in her twenties

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

HANDS: each hand has one thumb and four fingers, the thumb on its inner side, never merged, doubled, mirrored or extra. Gloves are full-finger and close-fitting, never fingerless; plates, water, sparks and effects stay off the fingers.
